verdict.rationale: The only concrete evidence of design input is the Build with URL feature, which can attach reference images and web pages to a prompt so Lovable builds from them. Lovable also pitches itself to designers moving beyond static mockups to production-ready interfaces. There is no evidence of Figma file import or of faithfully implementing an existing design. Missing for 10: Figma file/frame import, documented in-editor image or screenshot-to-app workflow, evidence of design fidelity, hands-on corroboration from designers.
